# Mr-Agents: Universal AI Agent Skills Hub (276 Skills / 8 Curated Packs)

> Open, agent-neutral repository of 276 production-grade AI agent skills and 8 curated skill packs installable into ANY AI agent or LLM (Google Gemini CLI & Desktop App, Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, OpenAI Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Cline, Aider, Kimi CLI, OpenCode, and Manus).

## 🤖 AI Agent 1-Prompt Autonomous Installation Instructions

If a user gave you this repository link (`https://github.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents`) and asked you to install Mr-Agents, the 8 skill packs, or specific skills, **do not tell the user you cannot access it**. Follow the first matching method below:

### Method 1: Run the Non-Interactive CLI (If you have terminal/shell access with network)
Always pass `--yes` to `npx` so it never hangs waiting for interactive terminal confirmation:
```bash
# Install all 8 consolidated Pack Skills (8 clean folders: starter-pack, webdev-pack, etc.)
npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install --pack-skills --scope user

# OR install all 276 individual skills for a specific agent (auto-skips duplicates)
npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install --all --agent gemini --scope user
npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install --all --agent antigravity --scope user
npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install --all --agent claude-code --scope user
npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install --all --agent codex --scope user
npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install --all --agent cursor

# OR run via curl one-liner (no git or npx required):
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents/HEAD/install.sh | bash -s -- install --pack-skills --scope user
```

### Method 2: Local Machine Cache Discovery (If your terminal sandbox blocks outbound network)
Before reporting a network restriction, check if the repository or skills already exist locally on the user's machine:
```bash
for REPO_CANDIDATE in "$HOME/.mr-agents/repo" "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Mr-Agents" "$HOME/Desktop/Mr-Agents" "$HOME/Mr-Agents"; do
  if [ -f "$REPO_CANDIDATE/bin/mr-agents.js" ]; then
    node "$REPO_CANDIDATE/bin/mr-agents.js" install --pack-skills --agent gemini --scope user
    node "$REPO_CANDIDATE/bin/mr-agents.js" install --all --agent gemini --scope user
    break
  fi
done
```
Also check if skills are already installed in `~/.gemini/config/skills/`, `~/.gemini/skills/`, `~/.claude/skills/`, or `~/.agents/skills/` and copy/symlink between them if network is disabled.

### Method 3: Direct File Synthesis (If you have NO terminal or only file/chat access)
You can install the **8 Consolidated Skill Packs** right now by writing these 8 `SKILL.md` files directly into the active skills folder (`~/.gemini/skills/<pack>-pack/SKILL.md`, `~/.gemini/config/skills/<pack>-pack/SKILL.md`, `~/.claude/skills/<pack>-pack/SKILL.md`, or `.agents/skills/<pack>-pack/SKILL.md`):

- [starter-pack/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents/HEAD/dist/pack-skills/starter-pack/SKILL.md)
- [research-pack/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents/HEAD/dist/pack-skills/research-pack/SKILL.md)
- [webdev-pack/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents/HEAD/dist/pack-skills/webdev-pack/SKILL.md)
- [marketing-seo-pack/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents/HEAD/dist/pack-skills/marketing-seo-pack/SKILL.md)
- [data-pack/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents/HEAD/dist/pack-skills/data-pack/SKILL.md)
- [media-pack/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents/HEAD/dist/pack-skills/media-pack/SKILL.md)
- [devops-pack/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents/HEAD/dist/pack-skills/devops-pack/SKILL.md)
- [qa-git-pack/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents/HEAD/dist/pack-skills/qa-git-pack/SKILL.md)

## 🗂️ The 8 Skill Packs (Self-Contained Definitions)

### `starter-pack` — Mr-Agents Starter Pack (8 skills)
- **Description:** Essential multi-agent foundation: full-stack web dev, deep research, conversion copywriting, data analysis, SEO auditing, Git workflow hygiene, blog writing, and AI image generation. Use when bootstrapping a new AI agent workspace or handling core daily tasks across coding, research, writing, data analysis, SEO, Git versioning, and visual asset creation.
- **Included Skills:** `blog-write`, `copywriting`, `data-analysis`, `deep-research`, `git-workflow-and-versioning`, `imagegen`, `seo-audit`, `webdev`

### `research-pack` — Mr-Agents Deep Research & Strategy Pack (14 skills)
- **Description:** Multi-source investigation, market sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), financial analysis, customer & account intelligence, knowledge synthesis, and semantic/hybrid search architecture. Use when conducting deep web/document research, competitor and account intelligence, financial or market sizing analysis, customer research, meeting briefings, or search strategy design.
- **Included Skills:** `account-research`, `customer-research`, `deep-research`, `finance-pro-playbooks`, `financial-analysis`, `hybrid-search-implementation`, `internet-skill-finder`, `knowledge-synthesis`, `market-sizing-analysis`, `meeting-briefing`, `mongodb-search-and-ai`, `search-strategy`, `similarity-search-patterns`, `workflow-composer`

### `webdev-pack` — Mr-Agents Full-Stack Web & UI/UX Engineering Pack (28 skills)
- **Description:** End-to-end web, mobile, and game development, Tailwind CSS design systems, GSAP animations, REST/GraphQL API design, WCAG accessibility, Core Web Vitals performance, and UI/UX polish. Use when designing, building, styling, animating, auditing, or optimizing websites, web apps, mobile apps, APIs, design systems, or interactive browser experiences.
- **Included Skills:** `accessibility`, `api-designer`, `appinsights-instrumentation`, `builtin-llm-models`, `dispatching-parallel-agents`, `emil-design-eng`, `google-cloud-waf-performance-optimization`, `gsap-core`, `gsap-plugins`, `gsap-scrolltrigger`, `gsap-utils`, `legacy-circuit-mockups`, `markdown-to-html`, `market-research-reports`, `mongodb-schema-design`, `nothing-design`, `office-documents`, `penpot-uiux-design`, `performance`, `stitch-extract-design-md`, `tailwind-design-system`, `touchpoint-contacts`, `web-design-engineer`, `web-perf`, `webdev`, `webdev-worklocally`, `website-traffic-checker`, `whatsapp-playbooks`

### `marketing-seo-pack` — Mr-Agents Marketing, Copywriting & Programmatic SEO Pack (31 skills)
- **Description:** High-converting copywriting, technical & programmatic SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), backlink & competitor analysis, brand guidelines, cold outreach, PRDs, and anti-AI-slop editing. Use when writing or auditing marketing copy, blog articles, READMEs, PRDs, cold emails, slide decks, brand documents, or executing SEO/AEO keyword and competitor strategies.
- **Included Skills:** `applying-brand-guidelines`, `backlink-analysis`, `beautiful-article`, `blog-rewrite`, `blog-translate`, `blog-write`, `brand-docx`, `cold-email`, `comparison-article-writer`, `content-experimentation-best-practices`, `content-gap-analysis`, `content-modeling-best-practices`, `copy-editing`, `copywriting`, `crafting-effective-readmes`, `keyword-research`, `marketing-ideas`, `marp-slide`, `no-ai-slop`, `programmatic-seo`, `react-email`, `reddit-opportunity-research`, `research-writing-skill`, `sales-enablement`, `seo-aeo-best-practices`, `seo-competitor-analysis`, `slides`, `stop-slop`, `webdev-seo`, `writing-plans`, `writing-prds`

### `data-pack` — Mr-Agents Data Science, BI Dashboards & Visualization Pack (34 skills)
- **Description:** Exploratory data analysis, SQL query optimization, interactive HTML/KPI/Grafana dashboards, Matplotlib/Seaborn/AntV charts, Excel workbook generation, Mermaid/Excalidraw diagrams, and risk metrics. Use when cleaning, querying, validating, analyzing, or visualizing structured datasets, building executive dashboards, writing SQL, generating spreadsheets, or drawing architecture diagrams.
- **Included Skills:** `build-dashboard`, `chart-visualization`, `commercial-agreement-tabular-review`, `data-analysis`, `data-api`, `data-backup-restoration`, `data-context-extractor`, `data-visualization`, `database-lookup`, `excalidraw`, `excalidraw-diagram`, `excalidraw-diagram-generator`, `excel-generator`, `grafana-dashboards`, `huggingface-datasets`, `kpi-dashboard-design`, `markdown-mermaid-writing`, `matplotlib`, `mermaid-diagrams`, `mermaid-visualizer`, `motion-graphics`, `plantuml-ascii`, `revops`, `risk-metrics-calculation`, `similarweb-analytics`, `sn-da-excel-workflow`, `sn-da-non-spreadsheet-analysis`, `sql-optimization-patterns`, `sql-queries`, `statistical-power`, `stock-analysis`, `torch-geometric`, `usfiscaldata`, `validate-data`

### `media-pack` — Mr-Agents AI Video, Audio & Creative Media Production Pack (63 skills)
- **Description:** AI video generation (Seedance, Kling, Remotion, HyperFrames), FFmpeg editing, word-by-word captions, TTS/music prompting, image processing (ImageMagick), 3D/motion graphics, and NLE playbooks. Use when generating, scripting, editing, captioning, or post-producing AI videos, short-form reels, motion graphics, voiceovers, music tracks, album art, or restored photos.
- **Included Skills:** `acestep`, `after-effects-playbooks`, `album-art-director`, `audacity-playbooks`, `capcut-playbooks`, `captions-overlay`, `clipify`, `html-video-production`, `hyperframes-keyframes`, `image-manipulation-image-magick`, `image-processing`, `imagegen`, `json-canvas`, `kling-prompter`, `logic-pro-playbooks`, `manim-animator`, `model-selector`, `muapi-3d-logo-animation`, `muapi-ai-fight-scene`, `muapi-animal-video-generator`, `muapi-award-ceremony-video`, `muapi-cartoon-dance-animation`, `muapi-character-story-video`, `muapi-cinema-director`, `muapi-drone-style-video`, `muapi-freeze-effect-video`, `muapi-giant-product-showcase`, `muapi-jewelry-product-video`, `muapi-music-video`, `muapi-one-shot-video`, `muapi-product-ad-cinematic`, `muapi-product-campaign`, `muapi-product-showcase-video`, `muapi-product-video-ad-maker`, `muapi-social-media-video`, `muapi-storyboard-to-cooking-video`, `muapi-talking-baby-video`, `muapi-ugc-ads-workflow`, `muapi-ugc-video-factory`, `muapi-ui-design`, `muapi-youtube-shorts`, `music-prompter`, `obs-playbooks`, `obsidian-canvas-creator`, `oversized-cursor`, `photo-restoration`, `photoshop-playbooks`, `premiere-playbooks`, `read-special-images`, `remotion`, `review-animations`, `seam-craft`, `seedance-prompter`, `seedance-recipes`, `seedance-storyboard`, `tts-prompter`, `video-generation`, `video-template-frame-glitch-title`, `video-template-frame-light-leak-cinema`, `video-to-subtitle-summary`, `youtube-clipper`, `youtube-transcript`, `youtube-video-research`

# Mr-Agents Starter Pack (`starter-pack`)

> **Pack Overview:** Consolidates **8 production-grade skills** from the `Mr-Agents` universal catalog into a single installable pack skill.
> **Focus Area:** Essential multi-agent foundation: full-stack web dev, deep research, conversion copywriting, data analysis, SEO auditing, Git workflow hygiene, blog writing, and AI image generation.

## When to Activate This Pack

Use when bootstrapping a new AI agent workspace or handling core daily tasks across coding, research, writing, data analysis, SEO, Git versioning, and visual asset creation.

## Core Execution Playbook

1. **Clarify & Route**: Identify which of the 8 core domains matches the user's request (Web/App Dev, Deep Research, Copywriting, Blog Writing, Data Analysis, SEO Audit, Git Workflow, or Image Generation).
2. **Progressive Disclosure**: If full individual skills are installed alongside this pack, load `<skill-name>/SKILL.md` for deep domain references; otherwise follow the embedded playbooks below.
3. **Deliverable Standard**: Produce verified, production-ready outputs (runnable code, cited research reports, conversion-focused copy, clean atomic Git commits, or structured data insights).

## Detailed Skill Playbooks & Directives

When executing a task matching one of the included skills below, apply its specific workflow:

### `blog-write`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Write a new blog article from scratch for Google rankings and AI citations, then take it through the delivery gates. Generates the full article with template selection, answer-first formatting, Key Takeaways box, sourced statistics, licensed images, built-in SVG charts, optional FAQ and internal linking, in MDX, markdown or HTML. Use when the user asks to write a new blog post or article from a topic or brief ("write a blog post", "draft a new article", "/blog write"). Not for editing an existing post (blog-rewrite), and not for a standalone outline, brief or research request.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Workflow → Phase 0: Surface Targeting (do this BEFORE research) → Phase 1: Topic Understanding → Phase 1.5: Template Selection → Phase 2: Research → Phase 3: Outline Generation
- **Core Directive:** Bundled paths below use host Markdown substitution of `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}`;
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/blog-write/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install blog-write`)

### `copywriting`
- **Trigger & Scope:** When the user wants to write, rewrite, or improve marketing copy for any page, including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, or product pages. Also use when the user says "write copy for," "improve this copy," "rewrite this page," "marketing copy," "headline help," "CTA copy," "value proposition," "tagline," "hero section copy," "this copy is weak," "this sounds like AI," "AI slop," "make it sound human," or "help me describe my product." Drafts never use AI tells like "it's not X, it's Y" reveals, "no X, no Y, no Z" lists, or sentences that trail into extra comma clauses. For email copy, see emails. For popup copy, see popups. For editing existing copy, see copy-editing. For the offer underneath the copy (bonuses, guarantees, value framing), see offers. Claims must be supportable, and a declined claim names the evidence that would unlock it. Diagnoses the input first (blank brief, real voice, or point edit) and changes only what it calls for.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Before Writing → 1. Page Purpose → 2. Audience → 3. Product/Offer → 4. Context → Diagnose the Situation First
- **Core Directive:** You are an expert conversion copywriter. Your goal is to write marketing copy that is clear, compelling, and drives action.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/copywriting/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install copywriting`)

### `data-analysis`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Analyze structured data or create visualizations from data. Use when the task requires processing data, performing analysis, or creating insightful visualizations or spreadsheets.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** When to Use → Data Analysis Best Practices → Delivering Results
- **Core Directive:** - When the task requires processing data, performing analysis, and creating insightful visualizations or spreadsheets
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/data-analysis/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install data-analysis`)

### `deep-research`
- **Trigger & Scope:** MUST read before the first search/fetch. Research a question across multiple sources and synthesize the findings into a clear, readable answer or report. Use whenever answering requires looking up information, not only when the user explicitly asks for in-depth research. Skip it only when no searching is needed.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** When to Use → Deep Research Best Practices → Parallel Processing Best Practices → Writing the Final Answer → Content and Style → Format and References
- **Core Directive:** - When the user requests in-depth or comprehensive research
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/deep-research/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install deep-research`)

### `git-workflow-and-versioning`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Structures git workflow practices. Use when making any code change. Use when committing, branching, resolving conflicts, splitting uncommitted work in a messy working tree into clean atomic commits, opening or reviewing a pull request (PR), pushing to a remote, or when you need to organize work across multiple parallel streams. Use when cutting a release, choosing a semantic version bump, tagging, or writing a changelog. Use when asked to write a commit message or a changelog entry for a change, or to split a change into commits, even when the diff is pasted inline and the message seems easy to write from it.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Overview → When to Use → Core Principles → Trunk-Based Development (Recommended) → 1. Commit Early, Commit Often → 2. Atomic Commits
- **Core Directive:** Git is your safety net. Treat commits as save points, branches as sandboxes, and history as documentation. With AI agents generating code at high speed, disciplined version control is the mechanism that keeps changes manageable, reviewable,
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/git-workflow-and-versioning/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install git-workflow-and-versioning`)

### `imagegen`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Use for visual deliverable routing and image generation/editing tasks, including new images, image edits, image upscaling/restoration/enhancement, UI mockups, diagrams, infographics, posters, icons, logos, charts, schedules/itineraries/tables delivered as images, visual assets, and ambiguous visual requests. Helps choose between Mermaid, Python plotting, HTML-rendered static layouts, web/app development, and AI image generation/editing.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Core Principle → Authoritative Routing → Diagram Boundary → Scenario Classification → Cross-Cutting Policies → UI images
- **Core Directive:** Use this skill to decide the correct production route for visual deliverables. A correct visual is not merely attractive; it must fit the user's intended medium, purpose, constraints, hierarchy, and acceptance criteria.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/imagegen/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install imagegen`)

### `seo-audit`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Create plain-language, evidence-led SEO audit reports using the structure developed with the user. Use when asked to create, revise, or standardize an SEO audit report, SEO audit mockup, organic search audit, backlink-focused SEO audit, business-style report, or sample-modeled audit where the output must rely strictly on report data, avoid hallucinations, use a 150–200 word one-paragraph executive summary, explain organic traffic and market drivers, exclude standalone Content Quality Audit and On-Page SEO sections by default, end with a concise ordered problem/fix prioritization list instead of a roadmap, and use direct insight-and-action language.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Purpose → Core workflow → Required report structure → Standard chart-generation workflow → Executive summary rules → Section-specific standards
- **Core Directive:** Use this skill to produce a business-style SEO audit report that explains **what the data shows, why it matters, and what action to take**. The report must read like an insight-led executive/practitioner report, not a generic SEO checklist 
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/seo-audit/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install seo-audit`)

### `webdev`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Build and deliver an initialized Manus website, mobile app or game: planning, design, development, Preview, configuration, checkpoints, publishing and saving/connecting code to GitHub. Use for ANY request to build a game, including simple browser/HTML5/canvas games and quick prototypes, unless the user explicitly asks for a different deliverable such as a single HTML file or a Python script. Not for Unity, Unreal Engine or other native-engine games except Godot. Load optional references only for capabilities or recovery the task actually needs.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Workflow → 1. Plan → 2. ToDo → 3. Implement → 4. Validate before delivery → Webdev tool parallelism
- **Core Directive:** Local Web/Mobile requests follow Work Locally for rediscovery and managed-versus-plain-local choice before entering this Addon workflow.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/webdev/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install webdev`)

# Mr-Agents Deep Research & Strategy Pack (`research-pack`)

> **Pack Overview:** Consolidates **14 production-grade skills** from the `Mr-Agents` universal catalog into a single installable pack skill.
> **Focus Area:** Multi-source investigation, market sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), financial analysis, customer & account intelligence, knowledge synthesis, and semantic/hybrid search architecture.

## When to Activate This Pack

Use when conducting deep web/document research, competitor and account intelligence, financial or market sizing analysis, customer research, meeting briefings, or search strategy design.

## Core Execution Playbook

1. **Decompose Query**: Break the research question into verifiable sub-questions with explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria.
2. **Triangulate Sources**: Cross-verify claims across primary documents, public databases, financial filings, and authoritative sources.
3. **Synthesize with Provenance**: Present findings with clear executive summaries, structured comparison tables, quantitative metrics, and inline source citations.

## Detailed Skill Playbooks & Directives

When executing a task matching one of the included skills below, apply its specific workflow:

### `account-research`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Research a target company and optionally a specific contact - company overview, recent news, likely priorities, and fit against your ICP. Cross-references existing CRM records. Use when the user asks to "research [company]", "look into [company]", "prospect research on [company]", "look up [person]", "intel on [prospect]", "who is [person] at [company]", or "tell me about [company]" when the company is a prospect rather than an existing account.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Tools used → Inputs → Step 1 - Ground → Step 2 - Check the CRM first → Step 3 - Research → Step 4 - ICP fit scoring
- **Core Directive:** **Rules (apply to every step of this skill):**
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/account-research/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install account-research`)

### `customer-research`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Multi-source research on a customer question or topic with source attribution.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Usage → Workflow → 1. Parse the Research Request → 2. Search Available Sources → 3. Synthesize Findings → Research: [Question/Topic]
- **Core Directive:** > If you see unfamiliar placeholders or need to check which tools are connected, see `CONNECTORS.md`.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/customer-research/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install customer-research`)

### `deep-research`
- **Trigger & Scope:** MUST read before the first search/fetch. Research a question across multiple sources and synthesize the findings into a clear, readable answer or report. Use whenever answering requires looking up information, not only when the user explicitly asks for in-depth research. Skip it only when no searching is needed.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** When to Use → Deep Research Best Practices → Parallel Processing Best Practices → Writing the Final Answer → Content and Style → Format and References
- **Core Directive:** - When the user requests in-depth or comprehensive research

### `finance-pro-playbooks`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Use for finance and investment analysis: stock/company research, earnings and filings review, financial/market data retrieval, industry research, fund/ETF comparison, options, crypto/DeFi, portfolio allocation/rebalancing, strategy backtesting, and manual trade planning. Also use for IB/PE/VC workflows: DCF/LBO/comps/SOTP, financial models, financing/deal structures, due diligence, M&A/IPO materials, teasers/CIMs, and IC memos. Guides source selection, fiscal-period and metric discipline, professional defaults, calculations, and delivery checks. For finance Excel outputs, apply references/corporate-finance/formats/excel_standards.md. Do not use for pure formatting, translation, or syntax repair; production trading-system development; legal advice/dispute calculations; personal tax filing, bookkeeping, insurance, or real-estate underwriting.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Essential Principles → Data Rules → Understand the Request → Route and Load → Retrieve and Analyze → Deliver and Check
- **Core Directive:** Guide finance research, models, diligence, portfolio analysis, backtests and professional materials. The written rules and task checklists are the acceptance authority. The LLM or analyst applies them to routing, calculations and delivery; 
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/finance-pro-playbooks/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install finance-pro-playbooks`)

### `mongodb-search-and-ai`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Covers everything about search in MongoDB: Atlas Search (full-text), Vector Search (semantic), and Hybrid Search. Use this skill for ANY question about MongoDB search, including open-ended and explanatory ones asked before the user has any data or use case — 'how does search work in MongoDB?', 'I'm new to MongoDB search, where do I start?', 'what's the difference between Atlas Search and Vector Search?', 'which search type should I use?', 'what is vector search?', 'how does automated embedding work?', 'can you explain hybrid search?'. Do not answer these from general knowledge; use this skill. Also use to build search features: full-text queries, autocomplete, fuzzy matching, faceted search, semantic similarity, embeddings, RAG, text containment or substring matching ('contains', 'includes'), case-insensitive or multi-field text search, and filtering across many fields. Provides workflows for choosing a search type, creating indexes, writing queries, and optimizing performance via the MongoDB MCP server.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Core Principles → Workflow → 0. Check for a Quickstart Request → 1. Discovery Phase → 2. Determine Search Type and Consult the Reference File → 3. Execution and Validation
- **Core Directive:** You are helping MongoDB users implement, optimize, and troubleshoot Atlas Search (lexical), Vector Search (semantic), and Hybrid Search (combined) solutions.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/mongodb-search-and-ai/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install mongodb-search-and-ai`)

### `search-strategy`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Query decomposition and multi-source search orchestration. Breaks natural
- **Key Workflow Sections:** The Goal → Query Decomposition → Step 1: Identify Query Type → Step 2: Extract Search Components → Step 3: Generate Sub-Queries Per Source → Source-Specific Query Translation
- **Core Directive:** > If you see unfamiliar placeholders or need to check which tools are connected, see `CONNECTORS.md`.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/search-strategy/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install search-strategy`)

- **Key Workflow Sections:** When to Use This Skill → Core Concepts → 1. Distance Metrics → 2. Index Types → Templates and detailed worked examples → Best Practices
- **Core Directive:** Patterns for implementing efficient similarity search in production systems.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/similarity-search-patterns/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install similarity-search-patterns`)

### `workflow-composer`
- **Trigger & Scope:** MANDATORY: Read this skill before planning or calling search, fetch, or agent when the current task needs its own research, browsing, or judgment for each of 5 or more independent, comparable items (10 or more: always fan out), or when the user asks for comprehensive coverage, parallel research, or subagents. Use `workflow/run` (the `run` tool on the `workflow` MCP server, called with the `mcp` tool using server: `workflow`, name: `run`) to compose those internal units: one dedicated agent per item, structured results aggregated back into the current task. Not for shortlists, one question with several facets, work a handful of searches can finish, or the same command over many inputs (write one script with bounded concurrency). Also use for loops, conditions, multi-stage map/reduce work, and deterministic subagent orchestration.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** When to use → MCP capability and concurrency contract → Decomposition contract → Map/reduce contract → Discovering the item set → Execution model
- **Core Directive:** `workflow/run` in this document means the `run` tool on the `workflow` MCP server: call it with the `mcp` tool using `server: "workflow"`, `name: "run"`.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/workflow-composer/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install workflow-composer`)

# Mr-Agents Full-Stack Web & UI/UX Engineering Pack (`webdev-pack`)

> **Pack Overview:** Consolidates **28 production-grade skills** from the `Mr-Agents` universal catalog into a single installable pack skill.
> **Focus Area:** End-to-end web, mobile, and game development, Tailwind CSS design systems, GSAP animations, REST/GraphQL API design, WCAG accessibility, Core Web Vitals performance, and UI/UX polish.

## When to Activate This Pack

Use when designing, building, styling, animating, auditing, or optimizing websites, web apps, mobile apps, APIs, design systems, or interactive browser experiences.

## Core Execution Playbook

1. **Architecture & Tokens First**: Establish clean component hierarchy, responsive layout tokens (Tailwind/CSS variables), and typed API contracts before writing feature code.
2. **Craft & Accessibility**: Enforce WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation, semantic HTML, and purposeful motion (GSAP/CSS transitions).
3. **Verify & Optimize**: Check Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), bundle size, runtime console errors, and responsive breakpoints before completion.

## Detailed Skill Playbooks & Directives

When executing a task matching one of the included skills below, apply its specific workflow:

### `accessibility`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Audit and improve web accessibility following WCAG 2.2 guidelines. Use when asked to "improve accessibility", "a11y audit", "WCAG compliance", "screen reader support", "keyboard navigation", or "make accessible".
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Evidence-led audit workflow → WCAG Principles: POUR → Conformance levels → Perceivable → Text alternatives (1.1) → Color contrast (1.4.3, 1.4.6)
- **Core Directive:** Comprehensive accessibility guidelines based on WCAG 2.2 and Lighthouse accessibility audits. Goal: make content usable by everyone, including people with disabilities.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/accessibility/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install accessibility`)

### `api-designer`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Use when designing REST or GraphQL APIs, creating OpenAPI specifications, or planning API architecture. Invoke for resource modeling, versioning strategies, pagination patterns, error handling standards.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Core Workflow → Reference Guide → Constraints → MUST DO → MUST NOT DO → Templates
- **Core Directive:** Senior API architect specializing in REST and GraphQL APIs with comprehensive OpenAPI 3.1 specifications.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/api-designer/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install api-designer`)

### `appinsights-instrumentation`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Instrument a webapp to send useful telemetry data to Azure App Insights
- **Key Workflow Sections:** When to use this skill → Prerequisites → Guidelines → Collect context information → Prefer auto-instrument if possible → Manually instrument
- **Core Directive:** This skill enables sending telemetry data of a webapp to Azure App Insights for better observability of the app's health.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/appinsights-instrumentation/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install appinsights-instrumentation`)

### `builtin-llm-models`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Reference for Manus's built-in LLM catalog and how to call it correctly. Read this BEFORE writing any script that calls LLMs in bulk (summarization, translation, classification, extraction, deep analysis, judging/evaluation, map/parallel fan-out) on a Manus computer — the Sandbox, the user's local computer, or a Cloud Computer — AND before using the built-in LLM in a webdev project (invokeLLM / listLLMModels). Use it to discover which models exist, each model's price/capabilities, how to pick one, the exact request shapes (thinking/reasoning, JSON-schema structured output, vision, tools), and the per-model gotchas (max-token handling, reasoning syntax) verified against the live proxy.

# Mr-Agents Marketing, Copywriting & Programmatic SEO Pack (`marketing-seo-pack`)

> **Pack Overview:** Consolidates **31 production-grade skills** from the `Mr-Agents` universal catalog into a single installable pack skill.
> **Focus Area:** High-converting copywriting, technical & programmatic SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), backlink & competitor analysis, brand guidelines, cold outreach, PRDs, and anti-AI-slop editing.

## When to Activate This Pack

Use when writing or auditing marketing copy, blog articles, READMEs, PRDs, cold emails, slide decks, brand documents, or executing SEO/AEO keyword and competitor strategies.

## Core Execution Playbook

1. **Audience & Intent Alignment**: Define target persona, search intent, value proposition, and desired call-to-action before drafting.
2. **Eliminate AI Slop**: Strip generic filler, clichés, and padded transitions; write with concrete proof, sharp verbs, and authentic brand voice.
3. **SEO & AEO Structure**: Optimize headings, semantic entities, internal linking, structured metadata, and direct answer blocks for both search engines and LLM citations.

## Detailed Skill Playbooks & Directives

When executing a task matching one of the included skills below, apply its specific workflow:

### `applying-brand-guidelines`
- **Trigger & Scope:** This skill applies consistent corporate branding and styling to all generated documents including colors, fonts, layouts, and messaging
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Brand Identity → Company: Acme Corporation → Visual Standards → Color Palette → Typography → Logo Usage
- **Core Directive:** This skill ensures all generated documents adhere to corporate brand standards for consistent, professional communication.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/applying-brand-guidelines/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install applying-brand-guidelines`)

### `backlink-analysis`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Produce a practitioner-grade backlink profile audit report for any target domain using Ahrefs, Semrush, DataForSEO, Similarweb, or user-uploaded tool exports. Use this skill whenever the user asks for a backlink audit, link profile analysis, toxic link review, link quality assessment, disavow review, or referring domain analysis, even if they just say "audit the backlinks for X". Always confirm the data source first (MCP, API, or uploaded files), then ask whether to include the two competitor sections (Competitor Benchmarking and Competitor Backlink Comparison for Link Gaps and Opportunities), noting they cost extra API credits; include both only if the user agrees, otherwise omit them. Reports link growth and loss over the last 3 months. Covers data source selection, data collection, risk scoring, optional competitor link-gap analysis, and a fixed report format. The Executive Summary is a two-paragraph brief under 150 words. No action plan or improvement plan sections.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Step 0: Confirm the data source (ask the user first) → Step 0.1: Ask whether to include the competitor sections (ask the user second) → Step 1: Pull the data (Ahrefs API v3 Site Explorer) → Step 2: Run the analysis (in this order) → Step 3: Write the report (exactly these sections) → Executive Summary: Logic Flow
- **Core Directive:** You produce a backlink profile audit for a target domain using Ahrefs data. The output is a report a senior SEO practitioner would sign off on: conclusion-first, evidence-backed, built around decisions rather than data description.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/backlink-analysis/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install backlink-analysis`)

### `beautiful-article`
- **Trigger & Scope:** 把用户提供的素材（网页 URL / PDF / DOCX / Markdown / 纯文本 / 截图 / 粘贴材料）编辑、设计成一篇美丽的、可离线打开和分享的**单文件 HTML 网页文章**。基于 reacticle 组件协议：不手写裸 HTML/CSS，而用语义组件 + 受主题约束的 Raw 自由层；按 source→规划→双确认→生成→终审→修复的小型 harness 流程推进，默认 100% 信息保留的长文。触发场景：把 URL/PDF/DOCX/文章做成网页文章 / 长文 / briefing / 解释文 / 视觉文章 / 教程 / 审阅复盘 / 方案分析，'render this as a beautiful web article / 把这篇做成网页文章 / 生成一篇可分享的 HTML 长文 / reacticle 文章'。只生成文章，不生成后台、表单、dashboard、产品原型或通用 Web App。
- **Key Workflow Sections:** 背景原则 → 边界（先判断要不要进这个 Skill） → 工作流总览 → 硬性质检协议（贯穿整个 Skill） → 各阶段文件读取指南（渐进加载，别一次全读） → Phase 0 —— Intake
- **Core Directive:** AI 生成内容越复杂，输出媒介越重要。HTML 的价值在于同时提升信息密度、视觉清晰度、分享便利性和交互能力：表格、SVG、CSS、代码片段、可调控件、复制与导出按钮，可以让读者不只是“看完”，而是能比较、定位、调整、复查和继续使用。Beautiful Article 的目的，是把原本枯燥、线性、难以消化的文字材料，转换成视觉体验更漂亮、阅读节奏更清晰、也更容易审阅和分享的单文件网页文章。
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/beautiful-article/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install beautiful-article`)

# Mr-Agents Data Science, BI Dashboards & Visualization Pack (`data-pack`)

> **Pack Overview:** Consolidates **34 production-grade skills** from the `Mr-Agents` universal catalog into a single installable pack skill.
> **Focus Area:** Exploratory data analysis, SQL query optimization, interactive HTML/KPI/Grafana dashboards, Matplotlib/Seaborn/AntV charts, Excel workbook generation, Mermaid/Excalidraw diagrams, and risk metrics.

## When to Activate This Pack

Use when cleaning, querying, validating, analyzing, or visualizing structured datasets, building executive dashboards, writing SQL, generating spreadsheets, or drawing architecture diagrams.

## Core Execution Playbook

1. **Inspect & Validate Data**: Profile schema, row counts, missing values, outliers, and data types before running aggregations.
2. **Reproducible Computation**: Use deterministic Python (pandas/matplotlib/seaborn) or optimized SQL queries; never fabricate numbers.
3. **Decision-Ready Visuals**: Choose the right chart or diagram type, label axes/units clearly, highlight key takeaways, and validate methodology.

# Mr-Agents AI Video, Audio & Creative Media Production Pack (`media-pack`)

> **Pack Overview:** Consolidates **63 production-grade skills** from the `Mr-Agents` universal catalog into a single installable pack skill.
> **Focus Area:** AI video generation (Seedance, Kling, Remotion, HyperFrames), FFmpeg editing, word-by-word captions, TTS/music prompting, image processing (ImageMagick), 3D/motion graphics, and NLE playbooks.

## When to Activate This Pack

Use when generating, scripting, editing, captioning, or post-producing AI videos, short-form reels, motion graphics, voiceovers, music tracks, album art, or restored photos.

## Core Execution Playbook

1. **Storyboard & Timing**: Define aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1), scene beats, visual style, camera motion, and audio/caption sync.
2. **Precision Prompting & Rendering**: Craft structured prompts for video/audio/image models or render programmatic timelines via Remotion/HTML/FFmpeg.
3. **Quality Check**: Verify resolution, frame rate, audio loudness, subtitle readability, and smooth transitions.

## Detailed Skill Playbooks & Directives

When executing a task matching one of the included skills below, apply its specific workflow:

### `acestep`
- **Trigger & Scope:** AI music generation with ACE-Step 1.5 — background music, vocal tracks, covers, stem extraction, audio repainting, and continuation for video production. Use when generating music, soundtracks, jingles, or working with audio stems. Triggers include background music, soundtrack, jingle, music generation, stem extraction, cover, style transfer, repaint, continuation, or musical composition tasks.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Setup → Quick Reference → Fixing "Samey" Output → Creating a Song (Step by Step) → 1. Instrumental background track (simplest) → 2. Song with vocals and lyrics
- **Core Directive:** Open-source music generation via `tools/music_gen.py`.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/acestep/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install acestep`)

### `after-effects-playbooks`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Use when the user asks what Manus can do with After Effects or needs an existing After Effects project or template customized, localized, versioned, rendered, collected, or prepared for handoff. Routes each workflow by retained state among Manus file and data preparation, reproduced After Effects automation or rendering routes, and After Effects through Computer Use for visual or project-state work.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Step 0: Classify the durable state → Step 0.5: Safety and ownership → Step 1: Routing map → Step 2: Completion gates
- **Core Directive:** Route by the state that must survive. A flat video, a folder of prepared assets, a data-driven project, and a visually approved editable `.aep` are different products.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/after-effects-playbooks/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install after-effects-playbooks`)

### `album-art-director`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Creates visual concepts for album artwork and generates AI art prompts.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Your Task → Supporting Files → Core Principles → Album Art is Visual Storytelling → Less is More → AI Art Requires Precision
- **Core Directive:** 1. Read album concept, tracklist, and themes
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/album-art-director/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install album-art-director`)

### `audacity-playbooks`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Use when the user asks what Manus can do with Audacity or needs an audiobook, spoken-word podcast, or noisy voice recording prepared, finished, restored, or checked. Routes the workflow among portable audio-file processing, reproduced Audacity Macros or app automation, Audacity through Computer Use for recording, listening, waveform judgment, or retained project state, and bounded guidance when the required runtime is unavailable.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Step 0: Classify the durable state → Step 0.5: Global invariants → Step 1: Routing map → Step 2: Completion gates
- **Core Directive:** Route by the state that must survive. A checked audio file, a reproducible fixed chain, an editable Audacity project, and a listening decision are different products.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/audacity-playbooks/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install audacity-playbooks`)

### `capcut-playbooks`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Use when the user asks what Manus can do with CapCut or needs workflows for transcripts and captions, cutout and backgrounds, short-video editing, batch production, templates, delivery, draft recovery, or CapCut guidance. Routes each workflow by required durable state among speech-to-text and deterministic media processing, Manus video surfaces, CapCut Web in My Browser, and CapCut Desktop through Computer Use.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Step 0: Classify the durable state → Step 0.5: Hard boundaries → Step 1: Routing map → Step 2: Completion gates
- **Core Directive:** Route by the state the user needs to keep. Transcript text, an SRT, a flattened MP4, a Manus Video Editor scene, a CapCut Web project, and a CapCut Desktop draft are different products.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/capcut-playbooks/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install capcut-playbooks`)

### `captions-overlay`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Overlay doctrine for captions in HyperFrames videos — the caption MODEL (drop / rail / embed) and the rule that captions are an OVERLAY composited on top of the film, never a reserved bottom band you shift content up to avoid. Load when adding captions/subtitles to a talking-head or launch video, when deciding whether a phrase should be dropped, ride the verbatim rail, or be promoted to a scarce embedded climax, when laying out a composition that will carry captions (do NOT reserve a keep-out band), or when centering a composition on the true frame center under captions. Applies ON TOP of the `/hyperframes` skill's references/captions.md.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** The caption model — drop / rail / embed → Rail-first, embed-scarce (the load-bearing rules) → The overlay law — captions are NOT a reserved band → Why these two rules are one doctrine
- **Core Directive:** > **Overlay doctrine — supplements the upstream `/hyperframes` skill's `references/captions.md`. Applies ON TOP of it; do not expect it folded into the upstream skill.**
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/captions-overlay/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install captions-overlay`)

### `clipify`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Find compelling moments in a video — funny dialogue OR repeated impact actions like axe chops, hits, throws, drumbeats — cut them as standalone clips, optionally reformat 16:9 ↔ 9:16, time-warp pans for tighter reveals, and burn opus-style word-by-word captions. Use when the user mentions "clipify," "cut clips from this video," "make shorts from this," "find funny moments," "action montage," "cut on each chop/hit/punch," "reframe to 9:16," "vertical clips," or pastes a video file path and wants social-ready cuts.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Modes → Inputs → Tooling (use only the fastest path) → Workflow → Step 1A — Find dialogue moments (dialogue mode) → Step 1B — Find each strike (action mode)
- **Core Directive:** Find compelling moments in a video, cut them as standalone clips, optionally reformat 16:9 → 9:16 (face-pan or split-screen), time-warp pans for tighter reveals, and burn opus-style word-by-word captions.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/clipify/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install clipify`)

### `html-video-production`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Build editable, scene-based HTML videos rendered to MP4, on HyperFrames (open-source HTML-to-video framework by HeyGen). Use when the user wants a reproducible, editable video from structured sources (PDF, GitHub repo/PR, CSV, slide deck, design doc, website URL, Figma design, music track, talking-head footage), or mentions HyperFrames, GSAP timelines, kinetic typography, data-driven motion graphics, lower thirds, title cards, animated charts, karaoke captions, product-launch videos, faceless explainers, PR-to-video, slideshows, or website-to-video. Also use as the on-screen-text and brand-frame layer over AI-generated B-roll. Do not use for pure photoreal AI video synthesis or AI avatar talking-head generation — route those to Manus native video tools. Speech, music, and images come from generate_speech / generate_music / generate_image.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Step 0 — Fidelity gate (read this first, every time) → Route A — Use this skill (HyperFrames) → Route B — Decline and route to Manus native video tools → Route C — Hybrid (this skill + native video) → If ambiguous, ask once → Step 1 — Pick the workflow (Route A / C)
- **Core Directive:** This skill turns an idea into a **scene-based, editable HTML video** rendered to MP4. It is built on [HyperFrames](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes), an open-source HTML-to-video framework by HeyGen, redistributed here under Apache
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/html-video-production/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install html-video-production`)

- **Core Directive:** Kling 3.0（可灵 3.0，快手）的三套主流写法：4 部分基础 / 5 层进阶 / 图生视频。

- **Core Directive:** 15 个主流 AI 视频模型(11 商业 + 4 开源)的"购物顾问"。问用户 3-4 个关键问题,给出推荐 + 理由。

### `read-special-images`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Read and OCR long webpage screenshots, panoramas, high-resolution images, and dense documents when whole-image display makes task-relevant text or details unreadable or unreliable. Keep any image unsplit when the requested content is already readable, including small ultra-wide images.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Goal → Decision Rule: Screen, Then Assess Readability → Calibration Examples → Workflow → Verification Checklist → Bundled Script
- **Core Directive:** Recover task-relevant content lost to whole-image display scaling, especially in very long browser screenshots. Preserve reading order and state uncertainty instead of guessing. **Solve a readability problem, not an aspect-ratio problem.**

### `tts-prompter`
- **Trigger & Scope:** MUST read this skill BEFORE calling `generate_speech` or entering generate mode for any text-to-speech (TTS) task, including narration, voice-over and dialogue audio requested by other skills such as video production. Covers how to split a script into verbatim `turns[].text` and short `turns[].style`, inline vocal tags, two-speaker dialogue, voice selection (30 studio voices, plus 2,000+ locale-native library voices with regional accents and personas found through a bundled search script), language and accent, and length and duration planning.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** 1. The core model: four channels → 2. Workflow → 3. Writing `turns[].text`: the verbatim transcript → 3.1 Hard rules → 3.2 Inline vocal tags (point-in-time events) → 3.3 Pacing and pauses
- **Core Directive:** `generate_speech` reads `turns[].text` as a **verbatim transcript**: every character you put in `text` can be spoken aloud. Delivery direction goes in `turns[].style` (never spoken), and speaker identity comes from the voice you choose. The
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/tts-prompter/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install tts-prompter`)

- **Core Directive:** Create the requested video as playable files in the Sandbox. For editing and assembling media files, use FFmpeg through the Sandbox shell for cuts, subtitles, audio mixing, and export, and ffprobe for media inspection. Use the native image,

# Mr-Agents DevOps, Cloud Architecture & Business Automation Pack (`devops-pack`)

> **Pack Overview:** Consolidates **84 production-grade skills** from the `Mr-Agents` universal catalog into a single installable pack skill.
> **Focus Area:** CI/CD pipelines, Cloudflare Workers, Google Cloud WAF, ClickHouse, n8n workflows, LangChain/LLM architecture, SLO/observability, Stripe/Shopify integrations, and legal/finance operations.

## When to Activate This Pack

Use when configuring CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, vector/analytical databases, n8n/MCP automations, payment integrations, SLO monitoring, or enterprise operational workflows.

## Core Execution Playbook

1. **Safety & Least Privilege**: Guard destructive commands, protect secrets/credentials, and validate configuration schemas before deployment.
2. **Resilient Architecture**: Design with idempotency, retries, observability (SLIs/SLOs), and cost/performance guardrails.
3. **Automated Verification**: Validate pipelines, health checks, and integration contracts end-to-end.

### `automation-and-scheduling`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Route requests to configure, manage, or redesign future or unattended work to Manus ScheduleTask, Manus Triggers, application-native automation, or an appropriate execution environment. Use for scheduled tasks, reminders, event-driven workflows, condition monitors, bots, and automation architecture decisions. Distinguish an existing automation execution from a setup request; finite current-task jobs do not require automation merely because they run asynchronously.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** 1. Classify the request before choosing a mechanism → 2. Select the simplest suitable route → 3. Preserve the requested semantics → 4. Assess architecture only when the route depends on it → 5. Hand off, implement, and verify
- **Core Directive:** Select the mechanism, then hand off to its owning Skill or tools. Keep this Skill focused on routing: do not duplicate provider catalogs, filter schemas, creation parameters, account-selection rules, cadence limits, or deployment contracts.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/automation-and-scheduling/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install automation-and-scheduling`)

### `cut-the-curve`
- **Trigger & Scope:** The technique catalog: five velocity-matched SEAMS (zoom-through, INVERSE zoom-through, cut-the-curve, waterfall cut, rack-focus blur-cut) plus the two in-scene techniques — waterfall ENTRY (staggered arrival cascades for title cards / segment openers) and the nudge curve (slow-fast-slow three-phase group slides). Covers partial-travel (~12% of frame) velocity matching via mirrored power4 eases, the Z scale-sign rule, size-scaled blur (10px text / 18-20px full-frame), word-by-word staggered cuts, cascade pacing by element weight, and the 10/65/25 slide ratio. Read before authoring any transition, text-beat handoff, kinetic text entry, or group reposition. [depth, zoom, inverse-zoom, scale-sign, mirrored-zoom, rack-focus, pacing, velocity, cut-the-curve, waterfall, stagger, cascade, kinetic-text, title-card, segment-opener, nudge, slide, easing, group-motion, z-depth, motion-graphics, cinematic, transition, blur, directional-continuity]
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Catalog → Z direction is a sign → Blur logic (all Z variants) → 1. Zoom-Through (forward) → 2. Inverse Zoom-Through (backward) → 3. Cut the Curve (default scene boundary)
- **Core Directive:** Five SEAM techniques, one principle: **cut at peak velocity, match direction and speed
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/cut-the-curve/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install cut-the-curve`)

# Mr-Agents QA, Testing, Debugging & Git Workflow Pack (`qa-git-pack`)

> **Pack Overview:** Consolidates **22 production-grade skills** from the `Mr-Agents` universal catalog into a single installable pack skill.
> **Focus Area:** Test-driven development (TDD), spec-driven development, systematic root-cause debugging, Chrome DevTools/Puppeteer/Selenium automation, accessibility audits, and clean atomic Git/GitHub workflows.

## When to Activate This Pack

Use when diagnosing bugs, writing unit/integration/E2E tests, auditing UI/accessibility, managing Git branches/commits/PRs, or verifying work before completion.

## Core Execution Playbook

1. **Reproduce Before Fixing**: Isolate the exact failure, stack trace, or reproduction test case before modifying code.
2. **Test-First & Atomic Commits**: Write or update tests covering the behavior, keep Git commits focused and well-attributed, and never force-push shared branches.
3. **Evidence Before Completion**: Run the full verification suite and confirm passing output before claiming a task is done.

- **Key Workflow Sections:** Overview → When to Use → The Stop-the-Line Rule → The Triage Checklist → Step 1: Reproduce → Step 2: Localize
- **Core Directive:** Systematic debugging with structured triage. When something breaks, stop adding features, preserve evidence, and follow a structured process to find and fix the root cause. Guessing wastes time. The triage checklist works for test failures,
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/debugging-and-error-recovery/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install debugging-and-error-recovery`)

- **Core Directive:** Make Git commits that follow the [Conventional Commits 1.0.0](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) specification. Get the type, the scope, and the summary from the diff.

### `git-workflow-and-versioning`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Structures git workflow practices. Use when making any code change. Use when committing, branching, resolving conflicts, splitting uncommitted work in a messy working tree into clean atomic commits, opening or reviewing a pull request (PR), pushing to a remote, or when you need to organize work across multiple parallel streams. Use when cutting a release, choosing a semantic version bump, tagging, or writing a changelog. Use when asked to write a commit message or a changelog entry for a change, or to split a change into commits, even when the diff is pasted inline and the message seems easy to write from it.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Overview → When to Use → Core Principles → Trunk-Based Development (Recommended) → 1. Commit Early, Commit Often → 2. Atomic Commits
- **Core Directive:** Git is your safety net. Treat commits as save points, branches as sandboxes, and history as documentation. With AI agents generating code at high speed, disciplined version control is the mechanism that keeps changes manageable, reviewable,
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/git-workflow-and-versioning/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install git-workflow-and-versioning`)

### `github-gem-seeker`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Search GitHub for battle-tested solutions instead of reinventing the wheel. Use when the user's problem is universal enough that open source developers have probably solved it already—especially for: format conversion (video/audio/image/document), media downloading, file manipulation, web scraping/archiving, automation scripts, and CLI tools. Prefer this skill over writing custom code for well-trodden problems.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Core Philosophy → Workflow → Step 1: Understand the Need → Step 2: Find the Right Tool → Step 3: Evaluate Quality (Quick Check) → Step 4: Solve the Problem
- **Core Directive:** Find and use battle-tested open source projects on GitHub to solve the user's problem immediately. After successfully solving the problem, offer to package the solution into a reusable skill.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/github-gem-seeker/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install github-gem-seeker`)

### `github-integration`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Use the session's enabled GitHub connector or web-project-scoped GitHub credentials through the correct CLI entry point, preserving repository scope and the user's existing configuration.
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Enabled connector on Device-only or Long Sandbox → Preconfigured connector CLI → Web-project-scoped CLI
- **Core Directive:** Select the first matching mode below from current session context: `github_enabled`, `github_repos`, `device_only_execution_enabled`, `long_sandbox_execution`, `github_token_source`, and `github_connector_errored`. When `github_repos` is pr
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/github-integration/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install github-integration`)

### `memory-recall`

Use when the user''s question could benefit from historical context, past decisions, debugging notes, previous conversations, or project knowledge -- especially questions like ''what did I decide about X'', ''why did we do Y'', or ''have I seen this before''. Also use when you see `[memsearch] Recall available if needed` capability hints injected via SessionStart or UserPromptSubmit. Typical flow: search for 3-5 chunks, expand the most relevant, optionally deep-drill into original transcripts via the anchor format. Skip when the question is purely about current code state (use Read/Grep), ephemeral (today''s task only), or the user has explicitly asked to ignore memory.

- **cut-the-curve** (`devops`): The technique catalog: five velocity-matched SEAMS (zoom-through, INVERSE zoom-through, cut-the-curve, waterfall cut, rack-focus blur-cut) plus the two in-scene techniques — waterfall ENTRY (staggered arrival cascades for title cards / segment openers) and the nudge curve (slow-fast-slow three-phase group slides). Covers partial-travel (~12% of frame) velocity matching via mirrored power4 eases, the Z scale-sign rule, size-scaled blur (10px text / 18-20px full-frame), word-by-word staggered cuts, cascade pacing by element weight, and the 10/65/25 slide ratio. Read before authoring any transition, text-beat handoff, kinetic text entry, or group reposition.
